data.title: Avery Kitchen on Instagram: Easy Tomato Pasta
data.description:
1,234 likes, 18 comments - avery.kitchen on August 20, 2026: "Easy Tomato Pasta
Serves 4

Ingredients:
• 12 oz spaghetti
• 2 tbsp olive oil
• 3 cloves garlic, minced
• 2 cups crushed tomatoes
• salt to taste

Instructions:
1. Boil the spaghetti until al dente.
2. Cook garlic in oil for 1 minute.
3. Add tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes.
4. Toss with pasta and serve.

Full notes: https://recipes.example.com/tomato-pasta".
